messages.name: addsnapshot
messages.description: Add a new snapshot. If there are no arguments, it will append the new snapshot to the current list of snapshots. If the first argument is a string containing a file path, Max will try to save a .maxsnap file to that location. If the first argument is a number, it will save the snapshot to that slot, incrementing subsequent slots. If the second argument is a string, it will set the name of the snapshot.

messages.name: deletesnapshot
messages.description: Delete a snapshot at the given index, decrementing subsequent slots.

messages.name: exportsnapshot
messages.description: Exports a snapshot from the given index, specified by the first argument. The second argument specifies the file name and path to export a maxsnap file to. If the second argument is empty, a File dialog box will open, allowing you to specify a file name and location.

messages.name: importsnapshot
messages.description: Imports a snapshot to the given index, specified by the first argument. The second argument specifies the file name and path to load a maxsnap file from. If the second argument is empty, a File dialog box will open, allowing you to choose a file.

messages.name: restore
messages.description: Restore a snapshot. Whenis on, the snapshot that is embedded in the current patcher will be used. Otherwise it will be loaded from an external file. You can determine the filename by an argument to this message.

messages.name: setembedsnapshot
messages.description: Set the embed state of the snapshot at the index.

messages.name: setsnapshotname
messages.description: Set the name of the snapshot at the given index.

messages.name: snapshot
messages.description: Create a snapshot. Whenis on it will be saved into the current patcher. Otherwise it will be saved in an external file. You can determine the filename by an argument to this message.
